assumptions: `municipality_only` was interpreted to include municipal parts explicitly shown as part of Opočno in listings, notably Čánka and Dobříkovec.
`chalupa` was searched as a house-like input type, but no credible retained chalupa listing meeting the parcel-size rule was found.
gaps: `reality.idnes.cz` search snippets showed Opočno listings, including Dobříkovec buildable land and sub-1000 m2 houses, but direct page fetch hit HTTP 429 and no detail-page URLs were safely recoverable from the snippets, so iDNES rows were not retained as sources.
`mmreality.cz` exposed an active Opočno house detail page in Družstevní, but the parcel area was 797 m2, so it failed the mandatory 1000 m2 land filter.
`reality.aktualne.cz` only surfaced `Opočno u Loun`, which is outside the target municipality and was excluded.
No credible retained house listing in the target municipality met the parcel minimum of 1000 m2 during this run.
Removed one stale RealityMix detail URL on 2026-05-25 after live validation showed the target page had been replaced by a generic 'requested ad is no longer in our database' page.
